Our Story

Every celebration,
in full bloom.

"மலர்" — Malar, the Tamil word for flower.

Like the lotus in our crest, we believe every occasion deserves to blossom beautifully. Based in Thenkiranur — minutes from Kallakurichi town — we are a premium wedding planner and event management company in Kallakurichi district, designing weddings, birthdays and corporate gatherings with an eye for elegance and a heart for detail.

From the first sketch of your stage to the final photograph, our team handles everything — so you can simply be present in your celebration.

  • End-to-end planning & coordination
  • Signature floral & stage styling
  • Professional photography team
  • Trusted vendor & catering network
Crafted with love, delivered with precision.

What We Do

Signature Services

Weddings & Receptions

05

Wedding photography in Kallakurichi and beyond — candid and traditional coverage, cinematic films, drone shots and beautifully edited albums you will treasure.

06

Sound, Light & Catering

FAQ

Questions, Answered

Everything families in Kallakurichi ask us before booking their big day.

Malar Event Management is among the most loved event companies in Kallakurichi district, rated 4.7 stars on Google. From intimate family functions to grand weddings, our Thenkiranur studio plans and styles events across Kallakurichi, Thirukoilur, Sankarapuram and nearby towns.

Every celebration is different. Simple decoration packages for small functions start affordably, while complete wedding planning is customised to your venue, guest count and design. Call 063790 05440 or visit our studio for a free, no-obligation estimate.

Yes — floral artistry is at our heart. Fresh garlands, lotus and rose installations, mandapam styling, entrance arches, car decoration and reception table styling are all handled by our in-house décor team.

Yes. Our photographers and filmmakers cover candid and traditional styles, drone shots, same-day edits and premium albums, so your wedding in Kallakurichi is preserved beautifully for a lifetime.

We are based in Thenkiranur and serve Kallakurichi town, Thirukoilur, Sankarapuram, Chinnasalem, Ulundurpet, Kachirapalayam, Villupuram and wedding destinations across Tamil Nadu.

For weddings and muhurtham dates, booking 2–3 months ahead is ideal; birthdays and smaller events can often be arranged within 1–2 weeks. Muhurtham seasons fill quickly, so call early to block your date.
